articles.title: Rocket the Raccoon to the Rescue: How Fifth Graders Are Easing First-Day Fears
articles.summary: At a Los Angeles elementary school, fifth-grade "toolbox coaches" buddy up with nervous kindergarteners, offering tricks like deep breaths and a stuffed raccoon named Rocket. The result? Happy kids, teary parents, and a smoother first day.

articles.title: Royal Rift or Just Clarification? King Charles Sends Letter Reaffirming Harry and Meghan's Status
articles.summary: King Charles has sent an official letter to clarify that Prince Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals after their return to the UK. The move signals concern about a possible "parallel royal court" and highlights the sensitive security debate.

articles.title: Kosovo Joins International Force for Gaza: A Step Toward Peace or More Complications?
articles.summary: Kosovo has signed up to contribute troops to the US-led International Stabilization Force in Gaza, joining a short list of nations. The force aims to maintain stability post-war, but disagreements over Israel's withdrawal and Hamas disarmament remain.
